sources.modification: Offline evenodd SVG fills with actual paint order, independent front/back piecewise transverse registration using original silhouettes and version-bound landmarks, documented distal exclusions, target-surface adaptation and <=0.01 logical px topology-preserving simplification. No mirroring or inferred dermatome numbering. V3.1 retains prior proximal geometry, registers original anterior V1/V2/V3 and dorsal-foot L4/L5/S1 locally, and excludes hair/complex ear/ocular/oral surfaces. Posterior plantar artwork is not projected onto the heel template.
